async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the a11yproject project details page
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, "The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com")
    # Wait for page load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Click on the Issues link to go to issues list
    # Assuming Issues link is in the main content or sidebar with role "link" and name "Issues"
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues", exact=True)
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Click New issue button
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="New issue", exact=True)
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Fill in title
    title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title", exact=True)
    await title_field.fill("404 for many URLs")
    
    # Step 5: Assign to myself
    # Find assignee dropdown, might be a combobox or button with role "combobox" and name "Assignees"
    assignee_dropdown = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assignees", exact=True)
    await assignee_dropdown.click()
    # After clicking, a dropdown list appears; select the option for current user
    # Assuming the current user is listed with role "option" and name matching username
    # Since I don't know the exact username, I'll assume it's the first option or has a specific text
    # In GitLab, assigning to myself might be a checkbox or select; I'll use .get_by_text to find my name
    # But without specific name, I'll use a generic approach: click the option that says "Assign to me" or similar
    # Alternatively, if it's a searchable dropdown, I can type my name
    # For simplicity, I'll assume there's an option with text "Assign to me"
    assign_to_me_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Assign to me", exact=True)
    await assign_to_me_option.click()
    
    # Step 6: Set due date
    due_date_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date", exact=True)
    await due_date_field.fill("2030-01-03")
    
    # Step 7: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create issue", exact=True)
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
